rule: For non-own, non-penalty, non-direct-free-kick goals, a successful opposing-team pass establishes a positive defensive passing interruption. Any possible assist actor must act after that interruption. Include every identifiable scoring-team event actor in the remainder of the frozen same-period episode, excluding only the scorer. No event-type touch shortcuts. Require two successive successful passes by the defending team before the boundary, with no scoring-team event between them, to avoid a single mis-coded interception being treated as controlled possession.
coverage: Use only complete scorer/team goal inventories and uniquely identified FPL participants. Reject intervening missing event type/team/player identities, except explicit card/substitution/formation/offside-provoked admin types20,17,18,19,34,40. Reject any interval containing deletion43/84, coverage interruption75/76, goal16 other than target, or set-play foul4. Boundary passes must precede goal by at most60 seconds in the same period. At equal boundary timestamps include all events rather than ordering by global IDs.
output: Candidate upper bounds only, including empty bounds. Never awards a goal assist. Missing identities or causal interruption evidence abstain. Existing positive awards and candidate denials remain protected.
validation: Freeze predictions and all2025 scoring-team plan before outcomes. Require at least20 applicable unresolved2025 goals, at least20 one-goal comparisons, no infeasible FPL team vectors, no incompatible one-goal vectors and no conflicts with previously awarded goals or source-certified positive candidate sets. No post-outcome threshold changes. Temporal/shared-source regression, not an unseen holdout or independent provider validation.
application: Previously unresolved pre2025 goals only; retain previous denials and complete totals. Derive a player total only after every goal contribution is known. Report field availability separately from source quality and qualified scoring.
